verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and calculates cost for each call, using built-in per-model pricing or custom costs, and shows these in the trace tree and calls table. That covers per-request visibility. Nothing in the evidence shows dashboards that aggregate cost or tokens by model or over time periods. Missing for 10: dashboard aggregation of cost and tokens by model, time-period trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call. Costs appear in the trace tree and in the calls table in the Weave UI.
Weave captures token usage from the API response and applies built-in pricing for the model, with no extra code required.
Add a custom cost with the `add_cost` method. The three required fields are `llm_id`, `prompt_token_cost`, and `completion_token_cost`.
